part: AO3401A 30 V P-channel MOSFET, SOT-23 (load-sharing switch)
notes: The datasheet's SOT23 drawing labels leads G/S/D but prints no pin numbers. The pin-1 dot (top view) sits next to the G lead and D is the lone lead on the opposite side, which gives the standard 1=G, 2=S, 3=D; that numbering is inferred from the drawing, not printed.

ratings.design: no USB: VGS = -VSYS ~ -3.0..-4.2 V; USB in: LS_GATE ~ VBUS-Vf vs VSYS -> |VGS| < 7 V even at a 6.7 V ring
system load about 0.5 A (up to 0.75 A in validation plan)

ratings.what: RDS(on) at the cell's gate drive
ratings.limit: 85 mOhm max at VGS -2.5 V, 60 mOhm at -4.5 V
ratings.design: VGS about -3.4 V at a 3.5 V cell
turns off when LS_GATE > VSYS-0.5 V; USB-in gives LS_GATE ~ VSYS + (VfD5 - VfD6) >= VSYS-0.1: off

pins.cite: p1 SOT23 drawing; p1 Abs Max; p2 VGS(th)

pins.issue: Source on VSYS, drain on VBAT: body diode (anode D, cathode S for a P-FET) conducts VBAT->VSYS as the design intends; channel conducts D->S in reverse when gate low.
